title: Website Opportunities: two sub-tabs (Find places | My opportunities N) kept in the page address; My opportunities pages 50 rows newest first by cursor, polls only moving rows by id, merges rows added elsewhere on top, bulk Resume/Cancel by job ids or by the filter on screen, falls back to the old whole list; one next action per row run the same from the table, the Inspector and the Details page
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout (dependencies installed) run the client test files named in run.cmd.
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: The address keeps wo-view, wo-stage, wo-q, wo-opp, wo-page and wo-brief beside tab= and other parameters, drops values it cannot mean, and writes nothing for defaults.
A page answer with counts/nextCursor is paged; one without is the old whole list, which the screen filters, searches and counts itself.
The poll asks only for rows whose research waits or runs or whose demo site is still being built, at most 100 ids a call; polled rows keep their place; rows added elsewhere go on top.
Bulk Resume takes paused, blocked, failed and cancelled jobs; bulk Cancel takes queued, running, paused and blocked ones; Select all matching sends the filter on screen.

Cancel and Resume call the job doors, Start research sends a request id, Build demo submits one durable demo action (buildDemo) and a lost receipt replays the same request id, Retry demo names the failed action under a new request id, Send demo opens the send step, Open the site goes to the site in Tracy.
The Details page reads the same Status and next action from the detail answer as the list row.

tests: the sub-tab, filter, search, open row and page are read back as written
defaults are not written, and other parameters keep their place
values a hand-edited address cannot mean are dropped, not half-applied
pageAnswer: a new server answers counts and a cursor; an old one only the rows
movingIds: research waiting or running, and demo sites still being built; nothing settled
chunk: the poll asks at most 100 ids a call
mergePolled: polled rows replace theirs in place; rows outside the filter now stay where they are
prependNew: rows added elsewhere (newest first) go on top; rows already shown are refreshed, not repeated
legacyView: an old server sends every row; the screen filters, searches and counts them itself
selectionJobs: the jobs a bulk Resume and Cancel act on, from the picked rows
createLatest: only the newest question’s answer is used; a late one is dropped
startingSubTab: the address wins; otherwise My opportunities when the account has any
cancel and resume act on the row’s latest job
Build demo submits one durable action; a lost receipt replays its request id
open the site goes to the site in Tracy; a row without one fails quietly
rowFromDetail: the Details page reads the same row the list draws, from the detail answer
My opportunities remembers its own Columns choice: Opportunity and Demo on, the other optional columns off until shown
My opportunities: one page by its query, and a bulk press with its request id
